issue: The in-figure title uses the British spelling 'specialised' ('Routing every request to the right specialised model (sequential cascade)'), which may conflict with the US '-ize' house style used in body text. The caption on the same page uses the noun 'specialist', so the only -ise/-ize occurrence on the page is the in-figure adjective.
evidence: In-figure bold title: 'Routing every request to the right specialised model (sequential cascade)'.
acceptance_test: Grep the source for 'specializ'/'specialis'; the in-figure title's spelling must match the dominant body-text convention for the same word (expected 'specialized' for a US-Letter book). If the book is uniformly -ise, no change.

issue: Caption states 'each depicted path a counterfactual completion', but one depicted terminal path is the limit-hit path ending in the 'Stopped' state (a non-completion / aborted request). 'Completion' is therefore inaccurate for that path; only the 'resolved' path is a true completion.
evidence: Caption: '...each depicted path a counterfactual completion, status [ILLUSTRATIVE].' Figure shows two terminal states: 'Final answer (emit, done)' and 'Stopped (limit, terminal)'.
acceptance_test: Reword the caption so the term covers both terminal outcomes (e.g., 'each depicted path a counterfactual trace/outcome'), or scope 'completion' explicitly to the resolved path only. A reader must not infer the Stopped path is a successful completion.

issue: The orange leader line for the annotation 'generated (γ=65/turn)' does not visibly anchor to the generated segment, because at the 0–14000 token scale a 65-token slice is only ~1.5 px tall (sub-visual). The line floats at the top of the stack, so a reader cannot tell whether it marks the per-turn 65-token increment, the cumulative T·γ, or simply the top of the bar; the only truly invisible component (generated) is the one with the ambiguous callout.
evidence: Panel (a) y-axis 0–14000 over ~330 px plot height ⇒ 1 token ≈ 0.024 px; 65 tokens ≈ 1.5 px. Annotation text 'generated γ=65/turn' with a horizontal orange leader line ending near the top of bars 3–4. Legend lists 'generated (γ=65)' as an orange-hatched swatch that is not resolvable in the bars.
acceptance_test: A reader must be able to locate/size the generated component without the legend: add a per-bar numeric tick for the generated slice, a small zoomed inset, or remove the ambiguous leader and add a note that the γ=65/turn component is below visual resolution at this scale (relying on the legend + the formula in Fig 19.3).
